versions.localizedDescription: Compacting no longer fails when the phone sleeps: the host keeps working and the app reports the outcome when it reconnects. Also: minimising the app no longer blanks the chat, a foreground lands at the newest message, and the chat's menu is a page swiped in from the right edge.

Minimising the app no longer blanks the chat, and coming back lands at the newest message. The phone's conversation menu is now a page swiped in from the right edge — the same verbs, swipe right or tap outside to close — and a chat no longer carries a three-dot button.

Compact says it is running on both apps (a spinner chip, a disabled verb, an outcome that is always drawn); the phone's item is no longer greyed out by a session id it learns late. Identical reads cost one round trip, and the model catalogue is cached for two minutes, so a chat stops queuing behind duplicate work at launch and on every reconnect.
The Mac has the three panels: Workspace, Skills and MCP servers.
Skills lists the bot's real index (236 here), and the two switches now reach the host.
